plotTwists: {user} declares {target} their bestie, and {target} reveals they already made a friendship bracelet, just in case.
{target} is so touched they immediately declare {user} THEIR bestie too, and it becomes an official mutual pact.
A stray cat sits between them, demanding to be included in the friendship.
The declaration is so wholesome that three random NPCs ask to witness it officially.
{user} gets so emotional mid-declaration they forget the ending, and {target} finishes it for them.
The Whisper Merchant appears, genuinely touched, and offers to forge a friendship bracelet on the spot.
Time loops back and the declaration happens twice, just as sincere both times.
